narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Twenty seven is a factor, because the list has a three!
<bookmark mark='three'/>But twenty seven is three times three times three, so it needs three threes.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The list has only one three, so it cannot give three of them to twenty seven.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says 27 is a factor because there is a 3 in the big list; 27 is split into 3, 3, 3 and the big list has only one 3; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='sum'/>Write the small number's primes, and if the big number can supply each one, it is a factor.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. One hundred and twenty six is two times three times three times seven. Are nine, fourteen and thirty five factors?
